email.description: The address to invite. An invitation always bypasses the domain whitelist — a developer inviting somebody by hand has already made the decision the whitelist automates.

role.description: The role the invitee gets on acceptance, by key. Absent means the app's `default_role`, and `409 target_state_conflict` naming `default_role` when the app has none. A key that names no role is accepted and grants nothing.
role.patternErrorMessage: A role key is lower-case: it starts with a letter and continues with letters, digits and underscores, up to 63 characters in all — `operate`, `night_shift`. A capital, a dash, a dot, a space or a leading digit is refused, and `defaults` is reserved.

display_name.description: An optional name to pre-fill the account with; the invitee can change it afterwards.

send_mail.description: Whether Fleetless mails the invitation. The link points at the app's `invite_url`, or at the Fleetless-hosted invitation page when the app has configured none — so the mail always leads somewhere, and nothing is refused for a missing URL.
